verdict.rationale: Dover documents AI-generated job descriptions, which covers one leg of the story. Outreach campaigns and "personalized emails in seconds" are not stated to be AI-drafted, and rejections use default templates rather than generated notes. Nothing evidences generation in the recruiter's own tone. Missing for 10: AI-drafted outreach sequences, AI-generated rejection notes, tone/voice matching, depth on how role context feeds generation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, AI drafts the words — job descriptions, outreach sequences, and rejection notes generated in my tone from the role's context

citations.quote: Get an AI-generated careers page and job descriptions
